notes: Same source fit IDs, 30 view schedule, model initialization, optimizer, response amplitude, loss weights, batch and 20-epoch budget as fixed-direction diverse-response control; only direction index uses source epoch.
For each physical fit position across 30 distinct source views, each of four directions occurs seven or eight times; the full 20-epoch schedule repeats each view twice.
Fixed source simulator action, receiver state and original observed noise; no full simulator or AGC rerun; synthetic directions are not proven TX identity.
Training uses no F weights/outputs, TX identity, V or target; frozen F only no-query smoke and final evaluation.
Fixed final epoch20, all seven predictions precede independent truth-last; historical ground test exposed, not blind or real satellite.
